The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46adc5be1070213b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 112. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume Gd for d < n. Let (Z, ∆Z) be a globally Q-factorial dlt compact Kähler pair of dimension n satisfying the resolution condition of Definition 3.1, with effective rational boundary and analytically nef adjoint L = KZ + ∆Z. Suppose there are a smooth compact Kähler manifold U, a projective resolution r : U → Z, a proper surjection f : U → Y to a normal projective variety, and a big nef rational line HY on Y such that r∗ L ∼Q f∗ HY (5.15) as actual rational lines. Then L is semiample.
